verdict.rationale: Puzzle's AI Close is documented as using AI agents to automate the month-end process. Per the docs, the agents reconcile accounts, review transactions and surface discrepancies, and automated work like matching invoices to payments is reviewed by the user before anything is final. All of this rests on short first-party one-liners without hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the end-to-end agent close workflow (matching logic, exception handling, review/sign-off steps), independent or hands-on evidence that it works as claimed.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent reconcile a month end-to-end, matching transactions, flagging exceptions, and preparing the close for human review

citations.quote: AI Close helps you automate and accelerate your month-end process using AI agents to reconcile accounts, review transactions, and surface discrepancies.
matching invoices to payments, pulling together what your accountant needs — described once, done automatically, reviewed by you before anything's final.
